'''These Rodians''' were [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] on board the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Their cell was adjacent to that of [[Kale Longo]] and [[Trig Longo]] and would usually stare at the two teenage prisoners. When the ''Purge'' broke down and a search party was forced to collect parts from an [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|abandoned]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] spread throughout the purge and killed all but a handful of survivors. The two Rodians caught the plague and died from it, only to rise once more as [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]].
